name: AcousticsSettings
doc: World-wide propagation constants, stored in project/world settings.

fields.name: speedOfSound
fields.doc: Speed of sound, for Doppler and reflection delays.

fields.name: airCoefficients
fields.doc: Air absorption per meter for low/mid/high bands: gain = exp(-coefficient × distance).

fields.name: occlusionRays
fields.doc: Rays per source for volumetric occlusion, including the center ray.

fields.name: maxPortalDepth
fields.doc: Maximum portals sound may pass through between zones.
